name: Roman numerals with strict validation
instruction: Implement int_to_roman(n) and roman_to_int(s) in roman.py for 1..3999 using standard subtractive notation. roman_to_int MUST raise ValueError for invalid numerals (repeated too many times like 'IIII' or 'VV', or bad subtractives like 'IL', 'IC', 'XM'). The two functions must round-trip. An in-repo test suite (test_roman.py) is provided — run it before claiming done.
